schema: S1 component envelope diagnostic, declared before execution, v1
purpose: Observe previously unmeasured live parameter changes and one-sample gate restarts; compare the accepted DnBOX core only where component orchestration is comparable.
candidate_mapping: Direct physical ADSR to current amp AHDSHR, with hold and release hold zero; no timing, scale or gain fitting.
verdict_policy: Diagnostic measurements only. Exact frame/word differences are reported, not treated as a predeclared acceptance tolerance. S1/SJ6 full-instrument admission remains open.
limits: Original source executes only in the comparison binary.
Retrigger cases describe a single original ADSR component receiving a one-sample low gate; they do not establish full-instrument note allocation or lifecycle.
Candidate comparison uses the public part/set-layer/note/render/read-voice APIs and makes no claim of S1 conformance.
No whole preset, original app, complete FX, target timing, or native hardware test is run.
